about: Reduce transparency (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx, step 3 amended 8 November 2026), followed live by the shell and an application with no restart. sample/MaterialProbe.tsx is the application: expo-blur's blur views over a target half black, half white, and the lock screen's clock in its material. Settings runs beside it (`companion`), granted `settings`. Its Accessibility page has Vision and Display as a Mac's. Off, the application's blur views blur their targets (the edge a ramp) and the shell's volume bezel is glass. Turned on, the session keeps it and tells every client. The host's expo-blur draws each blur view as its tint alone (the edge sharp, black and white under the tint), the clock's glyphs are plain white, the bezel is opaque (#1b1f27), and Launchpad's backdrop is an opaque dark grey (#2c2f36) with no wallpaper drawn. Turned off, all of it is glass again. Settings' switch is pressed where it is drawn (its row's text and the switch share its name): each press is delivered to Settings alone, and the application receives nothing.

steps.name: the application's glass: its blur views blur their targets (the edge a ramp), the clock's glyphs the blurred target
Accessibility, as a Mac's: Vision and Display, Reduce transparency off
its sections, Vision and Display, as a Mac's
volume up: the shell's bezel, glass over what is behind it
a press on Settings' window, on its Vision header: the window active, so the next press reaches its switch (a Mac's first click only activates)
Reduce transparency turned on in Settings: the session keeps it and tells every application at once
the application's blur views their tint alone, nothing blurred (the edge sharp), the clock's glyphs plain white, with no restart
Super alone: Launchpad, which takes the keyboard and the pointer from Settings
its backdrop opaque, a dark grey, no wallpaper drawn
Escape closes it: Settings has the keyboard and the pointer again
Reduce transparency off again, Settings' switch pressed
the application blurs again, with no restart
volume up: the bezel glass again
